facts.name: James W. Morgan III
facts.assignment: Listed under Circuit Judges on current roster; Plantation Key office. Profile biography describes 2021 county appointment and acting circuit criminal assignment in Marathon; practical procedures include civil, criminal and family matters. Exact current division allocation remains shared county review.

contact.contact_note: Civil case-manager email preserved exactly as published; surname spelling in email differs from displayed name. Office number, no separate assistant-only line or personal judge email.

scheduling.summary: File motion first; call/email JA with case number, motion, time and preferred in-person/Zoom platform. Coordinate offered dates with all parties, then confirm chambers before noticing; no unilateral add-ons.

communications.summary: Do not copy JA on interparty scheduling coordination. Scheduling party calls/emails JA to cancel and files cancellation notice; settlement notice alone does not cancel hearings.

proposed_orders.summary: Portal submission in Word/DJMCA format, separate PDF cover letter and referenced exhibits. Linked May18,2023 memo supplies formatting details.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email JA a hyperlink to hearing materials at least five days before hearing. Profile separately states clerk hard-copy identification exhibits due five business days before hearing; preserve distinct units.

remote_appearance.summary: Request preferred in-person or Zoom platform when scheduling civil hearing; published civil Zoom ID 915 4086 9408. Criminal Zoom ID differs; do not interchange.

noncivil_basic_operations.summary: Criminal hearings through JA; family hearings of two hours or less through family case manager for Magistrate Aliprandi. Specialized criminal/family requirements not analyzed.

review_scope.collected: Profile original HTML, collapsed/expanded text and DOM with timestamps, linked scanned3page memo and renders; reused roster.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, role statements, recurring civil scheduling/submissions/courtesy copies/appearance; memo format paragraphs and basic noncivil scheduling.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal pleas/arraignment/docket sounding, motion-specific continuance rules, trial-readiness and settlement litigation deadlines, specimen order substance.

conflicts.summary: Current roster places Morgan among circuit judges; undated profile biography describes county appointment in2021 and acting circuit criminal work in Marathon. Preserve differing role descriptions without determining their currency.
